profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Swiftly
profile.summary: Improving how the government serves the American people with tech via my work at Nava.

positions.title: Chief Architect / Cofounder
positions.description:
Goal: Provide democrats and progressives with tools that work at reasonable prices.

I run the backend. This involves designing, building, and maintaining backend infrastructure including databases, services, networking jazz, ops, etc.

positions.title: Outreach Specialist
positions.description: While working on my startup, I worked parttime at UW Allen School as an Outreach Specialist. I developed programs to make the department more welcoming and inclusive for all people. I started a seminar for new transfer students to help ease the transition. I also started two kids' summer camps: Leadership In Tech camp for HS girls, and Creative Coding for MS girls who were then mentored by the HS girls.

positions.title: Staff Backend Software Engineer
positions.description:
Backend Tech Lead for Organizing Team

Designed and built backend microservices for tools supporting our field organizers and critical campaign systems.
Mentored a team of more junior backend engineers, including one-off support for engineers on other teams.

(Note: I took most of summer 2015 off to honor a previous commitment to teach for GWC.)

positions.title: SIP Teacher
positions.description: I spent the summer teaching high school students coding and meta skills.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Teams: Video Chat (Hangouts), Google Docs (Drive), People Storage Backend, Google.org Giving Team

I also ran a lot of outreach programs for women & minorities in tech.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I built the research ideas for the Center for Technology in Learning.
